label: 33 Specialized Agents.
title: A Pipeline, Not a Prompt
details: One prompt can't write an investment memo. MemoPop orchestrates 33 specialized agents -- deck analyzers, web researchers, section writers, citation enrichers, fact-checkers, scorecard evaluators -- coordinated by LangGraph into a transparent, section-by-section pipeline. Every step produces inspectable artifacts.

label: Premium Source Targeting.
title: Perplexity Sonar Pro with @source Intelligence
details: Every memo section targets the right authoritative sources: @crunchbase for funding data, @pitchbook for valuations, @statista for market sizing, @cbinsights for competitive intel, @linkedin for team profiles. 80-90% authoritative sources, zero SEO spam. Citations are inline, globally renumbered, and consolidated.

label: Multi-Tenant by Design.
title: Firm-Scoped Architecture for Private Deal Intelligence
details: Each VC firm gets isolated configs, branded templates, scorecard criteria, and deal data -- all within a shared open-source codebase. Hypernova's evaluation framework stays separate from Avalanche's. Private data stays private. Branded exports in light and dark modes, HTML and PDF.

label: Your Criteria, Not Generic AI.
title: Scorecards That Codify How You Actually Evaluate Deals
details: Generic AI output lacks firm-specific perspective. Scorecards turn your implicit evaluation criteria into structured YAML templates -- team velocity, market timing, defensibility, capital efficiency -- whatever your partners actually debate in IC meetings. The AI generates analysis that reflects your investment thinking, not boilerplate.
